The section drawing is the specification for a glazing profile — we issue it per part on request, under NDA where required. Tell us the part and the format you work in, PDF, DWG or DXF, and we will send what we hold.
What is the minimum order quantity for this part?

We supply in bulk. For extruded profile the minimum is quoted against the die and your annual metreage rather than a piece count; for moulded parts it is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound. Prototype and first-article lengths sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes. Send a 150 mm length of the existing rubber and we will section it, produce a dimensioned drawing and confirm compound before the die is cut. An old glazing rubber has taken a set and shrunk — we dimension to the original section, not to the aged sample.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?
PDF, DWG and DXF for the section. A dimensioned cross-section with tolerances is all we need to quote a profile — a 3D model is not required. If you only have a length of the old rubber, send that.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness, tensile to ASTM D412 and compression set to ASTM D395 Method B are tested in-house.
What are your payment and delivery terms for international orders?

TT and LC accepted, discussed per order. Ex-works Nashik or FOB Nhava Sheva. Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin are issued with every consignment. Profile ships coiled or cut to length, as specified.
